props.name: accept
props.description: The file types to take, in the `accept` attribute's syntax, such as `"image/*,.pdf"`. The picker receives it as it is, and a picked file that fails it reaches `onReject` with `"type"`.

props.name: capture
props.description: Asks a phone to capture new media with the front (`"user"`) or back (`"environment"`) camera.

props.name: children
props.description: The button's label, which names it. The trigger renders the button and a hidden file input with no element around them, so it joins a `ButtonGroup` as a `Button` does.

props.name: directory
props.description: The picker selects a folder, and `onSelect` receives its files.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and ignores picks.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Takes more than one file. Without it, a pick in which more than one file passes `accept` rejects each of those with `"count"`. `accept` is checked first, so a file that fails it is rejected with `"type"` and never counts.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Receives the files that did not pass, each with its `reason`. For one pick, it runs right after `onSelect`, in the same task.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Receives the files that passed `accept` and the count rule, in a fresh array for each pick.

props.name: variant
props.description: The fill and text colour. The theme sets the `outline` border. `link` looks like an inline text link.

props.name: withIcon
props.description: Shows the leading icon: a camera with `capture`, a folder with `directory` and a paperclip otherwise. The icon is decorative, so the children name the button.
